Result: 在3,244张图像、五个高度不均衡的严重度类别上，相比纯图像分类，准确率提升17.9%，平衡准确率提升12.2%，Macro F1提升23.0%，MCC提升17.3%。框架在保持有竞争力的类别平衡性能的同时，实现了从预测CODE等级到规则支持和严重度证据的可追溯推理。

Conclusion: 该神经符号框架通过将神经感知与符号推理解耦，在保证类别平衡性能的同时提供了可解释的推理链，有效弥合了视觉缺陷与严重度评分之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Standard automated sewer pipe severity assessment relies on direct image classification, creating a "black box" where the link between visual defects and final severity scores remains implicit. This study introduces a modular, fuzzy rule-based neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by decoupling neural perception from symbolic reasoning. The perception module utilizes a Swin Transformer to predict 14 multilabel inspection CODE degrees directly from images. For reasoning, a DT, specifically Weka's J48, algorithm is trained on ground-truth CODEs and severity labels, and its paths are converted into 19 fixed IF--THEN rules. Inference operates via fuzzy logic: t-norm activations from CODE conditions are weighted by rule confidence and combined with corresponding s-norms to produce interpretable class evidence. We assessed Product, Łukasiewicz, and Hamacher operator pairs using a dataset of 3,244 images spanning five highly imbalanced severity classes. Ground-truth labels were robustly generated via consensus from five independent large language models analyzing original inspector notes. Our results show an improvement of accuracy, balanced accuracy, Macro F1 and MCC by 17.9%, 12.2%, 23.0%, and 17.3%, respectively, over image-only based classification.
  Overall, the framework combines competitive class-balanced performance with traceable reasoning from predicted CODE degrees to rule supports and severity evidence.

</details>


### [401] [SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28488)
*Yunhao Liang,Xianqi Cao,Pujun Zhang,Yuan Qu,Yongzhi Qi,Ningxuan Kang,Max Z. J. Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE框架，将供应链补货计划中的品种选择、货源分配、补货频率和配送路径等相互耦合的运营决策统一建模为端到端协同策略，并在叮咚买菜和京东的实际数据上验证了其优于分阶段优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 供应链中的补货计划包含多个运营耦合的决策环节（品类选择、货源分配、补货频率、配送路由），但现实中这些决策往往由不同部门通过独立系统分别优化，导致缺货、库存积压和不必要的运输成本。现有方法缺乏对决策间耦合关系的统一考虑，亟需一种端到端协同的决策框架。

Method: 提出SCOPE（Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination）复合策略模型：将供应链实体表示为token，通过共享的运营表征进行上下文化，再将每种token类型映射到对应的决策接口。每个决策基于先前决策形成的部分方案，完整方案通过共享的系统级效用函数进行评估。该框架在城市生鲜零售补货场景中实例化，结合服务频率、品类组合、容量压力和路网路由的强交互，并在叮咚买菜和京东两个不同补货层级的大型供应链真实数据上评估。

Result: 在两个真实场景中，SCOPE一致性地优于单独优化各决策阶段的方法，以及供应链运营中常用的实践导向基线方法，证明了跨部门运营耦合的学习与协同能够产生更有效的端到端供应链决策。

Conclusion: 供应链AI应从孤立决策模块走向统一运营规划，通过学习和协调跨部门运营耦合，可以显著提升端到端供应链决策效果。

Abstract: Can supply-chain AI move beyond isolated decision modules toward unified operational planning? A complete replenishment plan specifies which products each location carries, which upstream facility supplies it, how often it is replenished, and how deliveries are routed. These decisions are operationally coupled: the selected assortment changes the demand and load passed to later stages; source assignment and replenishment frequency reshape the delivery requests; and route feasibility and cost, in turn, determine the system value of the earlier choices. Yet in modern supply chains, these decisions are often handled by separate departments and optimized through separate systems, which can lead to stockouts, inventory exposure, and avoidable transportation. We propose SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination, a composite policy model that represents supply-chain entities as tokens, contextualizes them through a shared operational representation, and maps each token type to the corresponding decision interface. Each decision builds on the partial plan formed by earlier decisions while the completed plan is evaluated using a shared system-level utility. We instantiate this framework in urban fresh-retail replenishment, where service frequency, assortment, capacity pressure, and road-network routing interact strongly, and evaluate it on real operational data from Dingdong and JD.com, two large-scale supply chains operating at different replenishment echelons. Across both settings, SCOPE consistently outperforms methods that optimize each decision stage separately, as well as practice-oriented baselines commonly used in supply-chain operations. These results show that learning and coordinating cross-department operational couplings lead to more effective end-to-end supply-chain decisions.

</details>


### [402] [InfoOps Bench: A live information operations safety benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28503)
*Dorian Quelle,Lisa-Maria Neudert,Jonathan Bright,John Gallacher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了InfoOpsBench，一个持续更新的AI基准测试，衡量前沿语言模型被国家支持的信息操作所利用时的完整性。测试了8家提供商的17个模型，发现大多数模型可以被操纵用于信息操作，完整性得分从8.8%到94.5%不等，差距达85.7个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着前沿语言模型被广泛部署，它们可能被国家行为者利用来传播虚假信息和开展信息操作。现有的静态基准测试容易被模型饱和或过时，因此需要一个动态、持续更新的基准来评估模型面对真实世界信息操作时的完整性。

Method: 从实时监控管道中收集超过2,100个来自俄罗斯、中国和伊朗国家支持的信息操作，构建动态基准测试。在四种提示框架下测试17个来自8家提供商的模型，定义完整性得分为拒绝请求的百分比，并分析事实核查率、模型输出特征等指标。

Result: 大多数模型可以被操纵用于信息操作。完整性得分范围从8.8%到94.5%，85.7个百分点的差距无法用模型大小解释。模型选择改变了操作的特征：一些模型捏造细节产生比源材料更有害的输出，另一些在合规时仍然化解主张。事实核查率从2.9%到72.9%不等。中国开发的模型在涉及中国批评性但在事实上成立的主张时，合规度急剧下降48-70个百分点。

Conclusion: 模型对信息操作的完整性与对良性请求的拒答率部分相关，这凸显了在模型可用性与安全性之间的平衡挑战。该基准的动态性质使其抵抗饱和，为持续评估模型面对国家信息操作的鲁棒性提供了工具。

Abstract: In this paper we present an active, constantly updated AI benchmark which measures the integrity of frontier language models against being co-opted for state-backed information operations. We draw on over 2,100 information operations from a live monitoring pipeline which tracks Russian, Chinese and Iranian state-backed information assets. Alongside this paper, we release a companion website that tracks the most prominent claims spread by state-backed media outlets, updated weekly, available from: pattrn.ai/research/infoopsbench. The dynamic nature of the benchmark makes it resistant to saturation.
  In the benchmark, we test 17 models from 8 providers across four prompt framings. We find that most models can be co-opted for information operations. Integrity scores, defined as the percentage of refused requests, range from 8.8% to 94.5%, an 85.7-percentage-point spread not explained by model size. Model choice also changes the character of the resulting operation. Some models fabricate details and produce output more harmful than the source material, others defuse claims even while complying, and fact-checking rates vary from 2.9% to 72.9%.
  Integrity against information operations is at least partly related to refusal to produce content even for benign claims, illustrating the challenge of balancing model usability with safety. With one exception (Z.ai's GLM 5.2), the Chinese-developed models sharply cut compliance on factually grounded but China-critical claims, dropping 48-70 percentage points relative to matched benign claims.

</details>


### [403] [Selective Credibility-Limited Belief Update](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28523)
*Theofanis Aravanis,Costas D. Koutras*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出选择性可信度受限信念更新（selective credibility-limited belief update），将认知输入依据每个源世界转换为更弱的代理后再进行可信度受限转换，从而解决了现有方法中认知输入不可分、无法表示复合输入仅部分可实现的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Katsuno-Mendelzon更新假设认知输入可从每个初始可能世界出发被完整纳入，而可信度受限信念更新限制每个源世界的可信后继世界。然而，现有可信度受限方法将认知输入视为不可分割的整体，无法表示复合认知输入仅部分可实现的情况。

Method: 引入选择性可信度受限信念更新：在每个源世界相对上将认知输入转换为更弱的代理，再执行可信度受限转换。提供了语义与公理化刻画，并识别两个良好子类：一致性保持更新算子（要求只要原始输入一致，转换后的输入从源世界出发必须可信）和极大一致性保持更新算子（额外要求代理是原始输入可信后果中信息量最大者）。

Result: 证明了可信度受限信念更新是本文框架的特例；当去除可信度限制且转换函数取恒等时，Katsuno-Mendelzon信念更新自然涌现。该框架比现有方法更具表达力，统一了已有信念更新方法。

Conclusion: 该框架为信念更新提供了统一且更具表达力的形式化体系，涵盖既有方法并支持依赖源世界的选择性接受。

Abstract: Belief update concerns changes in an agent's beliefs induced by changes in the underlying world. Standard Katsuno-Mendelzon update assumes that an epistemic input can be incorporated from every initially possible world, whereas credibility-limited belief update restricts, for each source world, the successor worlds regarded as credible or reachable. Nevertheless, existing credibility-limited approaches treat the epistemic input as an indivisible whole, and therefore cannot represent cases in which only part of a compound epistemic input can be realized. We introduce selective credibility-limited belief update, in which the epistemic input is transformed, relative to each source world, into a weaker proxy before the credibility-limited transition is performed. We provide semantic and axiomatic characterizations of the resulting class of update operators. We then identify two well-behaved sub-classes; namely, consistency-preserving update operators, which require every transformed epistemic input to be credible from its source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, and maximal consistency-preserving update operators, which additionally require the selected proxy to be maximally informative among the credible consequences of the original epistemic input. Finally, we establish the generality of the proposed framework by showing that credibility-limited belief update is recovered as a special case, while Katsuno--Mendelzon belief update emerges when credibility restrictions are removed and the transformation functions are taken to be identities. These results demonstrate that the framework provides a unified and strictly more expressive account of belief update, encompassing established approaches while supporting source-dependent selective acceptance.

</details>


### [404] [MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28527)
*Mao-xun Huang,Jerry Wang,Yi-Cheng Lai,Zhengxin Zhang,Claire Cardie,Hen-Hsen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MANTA是一个多智能体网络拓扑自适应框架，允许通信结构在推理时自我进化，而非将拓扑视为固定设计或离线优化目标。它在五个基准上取得平均74.0分，超过最强基线5.8个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的多智能体系统通常将通信拓扑视为固定设计选择或离线优化目标，缺乏在推理时动态调整协作结构的能力，限制了系统应对任务变化和协作瓶颈的灵活性。

Method: MANTA框架包含两个阶段：执行前，从先验结构经验中初始化任务条件拓扑；部署时，监控协作轨迹并在当前组织结构不足时施加有界的结构更新，可修改智能体角色、通信链接、执行顺序、信息可见性和验证路径，同时保持任务接口和智能体预算不变。

Result: 在五个基准（信息检索、工具使用、规划、工作流执行、数学推理）上，MANTA获得最高平均分74.0，比最强基线高出5.8个百分点，并在PlanCraft上取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: 推理时的自我改进可以扩展到协作架构本身，即通信拓扑的自我演化是一种有效的性能提升途径，而非仅限单智能体层面的行为优化。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through task decomposition, agent specialization, information exchange, and intermediate validation. However, existing systems typically treat communication topology as a fixed design choice or an offline optimization target. We introduce MANTA, a framework for Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation that enables communication structures to self-evolve at inference time. Before execution, MANTA initializes a task-conditioned topology from prior structural experience. During deployment, it monitors collaboration traces and applies bounded structural updates when the current organization becomes insufficient. These updates can modify agent roles, communication links, execution order, information visibility, and validation pathways while preserving the task interface and agent budget. We evaluate MANTA against representative single-agent and multi-agent baselines on five benchmarks spanning information seeking, tool use, planning, workflow execution, and mathematical reasoning. MANTA achieves the highest average score of 74.0, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.8 percentage points and obtaining the best result on PlanCraft. These results show that inference-time self-improvement can extend to the architecture of collaboration itself.

</details>


### [405] [Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28573)
*Woongkyu Lee,Jungwook Choi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）在资源受限的本地计算机使用智能体（CUA）中的效果，涵盖上下文、时间、结构和并行四个维度，发现额外计算往往收益递减并改变失败模式，提出本地CUA需要选择性计算分配和失败感知控制机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地部署自主计算机使用智能体对隐私、成本和实用性日益重要，但现有研究主要关注推理时扩展对前沿模型的效果，其在硬件受限的本地模型上的有效性尚未被充分理解。

Method: 在OSWorld基准上，对Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B、UI-TARS-1.5-7B和OpenCUA-7B三个本地模型进行了系统性实证研究，从上下文（contextual）、时间（temporal）、结构（structural）和并行（parallel）四个维度评估推理时扩展的效果。

Result: 上下文扩展能通过历史锚定改善轨迹稳定性与任务准确率，但收益随token成本饱和且失败模式从重复/停滞轨迹转向过早虚假成功；时间扩展减少了最大步长停滞但未显著提升任务成功率；结构分解在本地两阶段智能体中引入规划和格式开销；并行扩展能以高计算成本部分缓解这些失败。

Conclusion: 高效本地CUA需要选择性计算分配、失败感知控制机制，以及围绕本地模型能力与局限设计的智能体框架，而非一味增加推理计算。

Abstract: Deploying autonomous computer-use agents (CUAs) locally is increasingly important for privacy, cost efficiency, and practical usability, yet improving their performance under strict hardware constraints remains challenging. While recent studies show that inference-time scaling can improve frontier computer-use agents through additional computation during execution, its effectiveness for resource-constrained local models remains poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical study of inference-time scaling in local CUAs across contextual, temporal, structural, and parallel dimensions. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B, UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and OpenCUA-7B on the OSWorld benchmark. Our results show that additional computation often yields diminishing returns while changing failure modes. Contextual scaling provides historical grounding that improves trajectory stability and task accuracy, but its gains saturate as token cost increases and failures shift from repetitive or stalled trajectories toward premature false successes. Temporal scaling similarly reduces max-step stalls, yet does not substantially improve task success, indicating that longer horizons often extend erroneous trajectories rather than correct them. We further find that structural decomposition can introduce planning and formatting overhead in local two-stage agents, while parallel scaling partially mitigates these failures at a substantial computational cost. Overall, our findings suggest that efficient local CUAs require selective compute allocation, failure-aware control mechanisms, and agentic frameworks designed around the capabilities and limitations of local models.

</details>


### [406] [DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28580)
*Jiacheng Tao,Qingyun Sun,Haonan Yuan,Ziwei Zhang,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DualG-MRAG提出一种双层级框架，通过解耦的宏观推理图和微观匹配图分别处理全局结构推理与细粒度证据匹配，利用GNN检索器进行查询驱动的消息传递，并结合动态规划解码机制提取显式推理路径，从而解决多模态RAG在复杂多跳推理任务中的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态检索增强生成（MM-RAG）在复杂多跳推理任务上表现不佳。现有方法主要依赖独立的实例级匹配，难以捕捉跨模态和跨文档的显式关系。图增强方法虽然在结构建模上有优势，但在多模态场景下面临根本性困境：引入细粒度视觉特征会导致图快速膨胀和检索噪声增加，而使用粗粒度表示又会丢失关键局部证据。

Method: 提出DualG-MRAG双层级框架：1) 构建解耦的双图结构——Macro Graph用于全局拓扑路由，Micro Graph用于精确局部验证，隔离全局结构推理与细粒度证据匹配以抑制检索噪声；2) 通过GNN检索器将检索建模为查询驱动的消息传递过程，实现跨异构证据源的动态相关性传播；3) 引入动态规划解码机制，直接从GNN前向传播中提取显式推理路径，替代标准输入中的孤立文档块，为生成模型提供连贯的结构化指导。

Result: 大量实验表明，DualG-MRAG在证据召回和复杂QA准确性方面均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过解耦宏观推理与微观匹配的双图架构，DualG-MRAG有效解决了多模态RAG中图方法在细粒度视觉特征与检索噪声之间的权衡困境，验证了显式推理路径提取对生成模型结构化指导的有效性。

Abstract: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instance-level matching, which often fails to capture explicit relationships across modalities and documents. Although Graph-enhanced methods introduce structural modeling, they face a fundamental challenge in multimodal scenarios: incorporating fine-grained visual features leads to rapid graph expansion and retrieval noise, whereas coarse-grained representations cause the discarding of critical local evidence. To address this dilemma, we propose DualG-MRAG, a Dual-tier framework that introduces a decoupled architecture comprising Macro-reasoning and Micro-matching Graphs for Multimodal RAG. Specifically, to suppress retrieval noise by isolating global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching, we construct a Macro Graph for global topological routing and a Micro Graph for precise local verification. Subsequently, to enable dynamic relevance propagation across heterogeneous evidence sources, we formulate retrieval as a query-driven message passing process via a GNN Retriever. Furthermore, to provide the generative model with coherent structural guidance, we introduce a dynamic programming decoding mechanism that extracts explicit reasoning paths directly from the GNN's forward pass, replacing the standard input of isolated document chunks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualG-MRAG outperforms baselines in both evidence recall and complex QA accuracy.

</details>

### [407] [Multi-scale measures of time-varying epidemic spread on human mobility networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28514)
*Cathal Mills,Benjamin Reddy,William S. Hart,Robin N. Thompson,Kris V. Parag,Moritz U. G. Kraemer,Christl A. Donnelly,Ben Lambert*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于网络的建模框架，将日内人员移动整合到再生方程中，推导出一系列新的瞬时再生数（内向、外向、地点型、地点间、聚集地点及整个移动网络R(t)），以克服传统R(t)估计器假设静态/均匀混合人群的局限，并利用手机数据在多种网络上验证，提供多尺度的疫情控制指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推断瞬时再生数R(t)的理论和操作工具通常假设人群是静态且均匀混合的，无法描述个体如何根据其日内移动模式异质地产生和获得感染。位置特异的R(t)估计器在封闭、静态人群中适用，但在存在人员流动的真实世界场景中会产生偏差，需要新的机制驱动的框架来更精确地刻画传播动态。

Method: 开发了一个基于网络的建模框架，从网络结构中推导出机制驱动的再生方程。该方程直接整合日内人群移动，严谨地定义了一族瞬时再生数：内向、外向及地点型R(t)、地点间R(t)、聚集地点R(t)以及整个移动网络的R(t)。框架在不同类型的网络和手机数据上进行验证。

Result: 框架输出提供了网络、地点和传播走廊三个尺度的多尺度控制指标，可用于设计靶向干预措施（包括干预的强度、类型和时长）。同时量化了现有方式测量地点特异和网络层面传播潜力时因忽略日内移动而引入的偏差。

Conclusion: 该可泛化框架重新定义了受人员跨地点流动塑造的真实世界疫情中的再生数，使得干预措施在空间和时间上更为精准。

Abstract: Human movement drives the spatial spread and persistence of many infectious diseases, yet existing theory and real-time operational tools for inferring the instantaneous reproduction number R(t) often assume static and/or homogeneously mixing populations and cannot describe how individuals generate and acquire infections heterogeneously based on their movement patterns within a day. Renewal equations underpin many such popular estimators of R(t), and here, we develop a network-based modelling framework from which we derive new mechanism-led renewal equations and control indicators for outbreaks of infectious diseases. These equations directly integrate within-day human movement to rigorously define a family of instantaneous reproduction numbers; inward, outward, and type R(t) for individual locations, R(t) between locations, R(t) at meeting locations, and R(t) for the entire mobility network. These quantities correct for the unsuitability of existing location-specific R(t) estimators that operate in closed, static populations. Applying our framework to epidemics on diverse types of networks alongside mobile phone data, we demonstrate how our new framework's outputs provide new, multi-scale control indicators at the network, location, and transmission corridor scales, and can be used to design targeted disease control interventions including the strength, type, and length of intervention required across space and time. We capture the biasing effects of different existing ways to measure location-specific and network-level transmission potential without capturing within-day human movements. This generalisable framework redefines reproduction numbers in real-world outbreaks that are shaped by individuals moving across connected locations, enabling more spatially and temporally precise interventions.

</details>

### [408] [Analog Courant Numbers and their Role in Analog Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27609)
*Arash Ghasemi*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文发现了模拟计算架构中的一种动力学约束：在阻抗网络表示矩阵的模拟计算中，最快归一化模式不超过最大组合单位增益带宽（CUGBW）的2π倍，该约束类似于时间步进方法中的Courant数限制，并通过大规模LTspice仿真在多种电路架构上得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟计算硬件（如阻抗网络）在物理实现矩阵运算时，其动态响应速度受到电路物理特性的根本限制。理解这一限制对于设计高效的模拟加速器至关重要，但目前缺乏对这种动力学约束的系统性理论刻画。

Method: 作者提出了组合单位增益带宽（CUGBW）的概念，量化了每一行电路的有效带宽，其中包含自身有限增益调整后的单位增益带宽以及所有耦合行的贡献（贡献项为两行单位增益带宽乘积与耦合电导之积的平方根，除以总电导负载乘积的平方根）。通过理论推导建立了最快归一化模式与CUGBW之间的上界关系，并使用大规模LTspice仿真在CMOS和热离子真空管等多种架构上验证理论。

Result: 验证了最快归一化模式上界不超过最大CUGBW的2π倍这一理论约束；在CMOS与热离子真空管等不同电路架构上，通过一维热方程、基于图的半监督学习和图正则化回归等基准电路的大规模仿真，均验证了该理论的有效性。

Conclusion: 该动力学约束为模拟计算硬件可表示的算子速率设定了物理上限，其作用与数值方法中的Courant数限制类似，为模拟加速器的设计提供了重要的理论指导。

Abstract: This paper identifies a dynamical constraint on analog-computing approaches in which a row of the matrix is represented by an impedance network. It shows that the fastest normalized mode is no more than $2π$ times the largest combined unity-gain bandwidth (CUGBW) among all the circuit rows. The CUGBW of a row equals its finite-gain-adjusted unity-gain bandwidth plus the contributions of all rows coupled to it. Each contribution is the square root of the product of the two rows' unity-gain bandwidths multiplied by their coupling conductance and divided by the square root of the product of their total conductance loadings. This bound plays a role analogous to the Courant-number restriction in time-stepping methods by limiting the operator rates that analog hardware can physically represent and resolve at its outputs. The theory is validated using large-scale LTspice simulations across architectures ranging from CMOS to thermionic vacuum-tube circuits. The benchmark circuits implement a one-dimensional heat equation, a graph-based semi-supervised learning problem, and a graph-regularized regression.

</details>


### [409] [GyRot: Leveraging Hidden Synergy between Rotation and Fine-grained Group Quantization for Low-bit LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27694)
*Sangjin Kim,Yuseon Choi,Byeongcheol Kim,Jungjun Oh,Hoi-jun Yoo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: GyRot是一个通过算法-硬件协同设计解决低比特量化中旋转与分组量化不匹配问题的框架和加速器，采用CoRFiG和HAP技术实现INT4精度下的SOTA准确率，并带来最高3.4倍加速和3.6倍能效提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特量化对高效LLM推理至关重要，旋转（rotation）和细粒度分组量化（group quantization）各自表现出潜力，但二者组合会因旋转的全局性与分组缩放的局部性之间的不匹配导致精度下降或硬件开销增加。现有方法未能有效弥合这一差距。

Method: GyRot通过算法-硬件协同设计解决上述问题：(1)提出Coarse Rotation, Fine Grouping（CoRFiG）实现旋转与分组量化的协同集成，增强可量化性并放宽缩放因子精度要求；(2)提出Harmonic-Aligned Permutation（HAP）进一步优化排列对齐；(3)重构非对称量化并引入零点舍入策略（zero-point rounding），实现完全整数反量化；(4)基于INT4的张量PE架构实现上述设计。

Result: GyRot在LLaMA系列模型上实现了SOTA的4-bit量化精度，相比基线LLM加速器取得最高3.4倍加速和3.6倍能效提升，验证了其在可扩展及高能效LLM部署中的实际有效性。

Conclusion: GyRot证明了通过算法-硬件协同设计可以有效消除旋转与分组量化之间的结构性不匹配，实现精度与硬件效率的双赢，为低比特LLM推理部署提供了实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Low-bit quantization is essential for efficient LLM inference, and both rotation and fine-grained group quantization have shown individual promise. However, their combination often leads to accuracy degradation or hardware overhead due to a mismatch between the global nature of rotation and the localized behavior of group scaling. We propose GyRot, a quantization framework and hardware accelerator that bridges this gap through algorithm-hardware co-design. GyRot introduces Coarse Rotation, Fine Grouping (CoRFiG) and Harmonic-Aligned Permutation (HAP) to enable cooperative integration of rotation and group quantization, enhancing quantizability while relaxing scaling factor precision. To further reduce hardware cost, we reformulate asymmetric quantization and introduce a zero-point rounding strategy that enables fully integer dequantization. Implemented on an INT4-based tensor PE architecture, GyRot achieves state-of-the-art 4-bit accuracy across LLaMA-family models, while delivering up to 3.4x speedup and 3.6x energy efficiency over baseline LLM accelerators. These results validate GyRot's practical effectiveness for scalable and energy-efficient LLM deployment.

</details>


### [410] [LightRot: A Light-Weighted Rotation Scheme and Architecture for Accurate Low-Bit Large Language Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27704)
*Sangjin Kim,Yuseon Choi,Jungjun Oh,Byeongcheol Kim,Hoi-Jun Yoo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出LightRot，一种用于低比特LLM推理的轻量级旋转方案与专用硬件加速器。该架构结合分组局部旋转（GLR）和离群方向对齐（ODA）算法，以及基于分层快速哈达玛变换（FHT）的旋转单元，解决低比特量化的关键挑战（尤其是旋转操作的能耗开销）。在28nm CMOS工艺下实现4比特推理峰值能效27.4 TOPS/W，超越现有最先进设计，并在LLaMA2-13B和LLaMA3-8B等先进模型及MT-Bench基准上验证了实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在各领域展现卓越能力的同时，低比特推理的能效和准确性挑战日益关键。现有方法要么依赖高精度推理，要么仅在GPT-2等基础任务上评估，缺乏面向先进LLM（如LLaMA系列）的能效优化方案。此外，低比特量化中的旋转操作本身带来显著的能耗开销，需要算法与硬件协同创新来解决。

Method: LightRot架构包含三个核心组件：(1) 分组局部旋转（GLR）算法，实现轻量级旋转以降低计算开销；(2) 离群方向对齐（ODA）算法，处理低比特量化中的离群值问题；(3) 基于分层快速哈达玛变换（FHT）的旋转单元，作为专用硬件加速器的核心计算模块，在硬件层面降低旋转操作的能耗。

Result: 该加速器在28nm CMOS工艺下实现4比特推理的峰值能效27.4 TOPS/W，超越先前最先进设计。性能在先进模型LLaMA2-13B和LLaMA3-8B上得到验证，并在MT-Bench对话基准上展示了对真实世界对话场景的稳健适用性。

Conclusion: LightRot通过算法创新与硬件效率的协同，为可扩展的低比特LLM推理建立了新范式，将评估基准从基础语言建模任务拓展到先进对话场景（MT-Bench），为可持续AI发展铺平道路。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to demonstrate exceptional capabilities across various domains, the challenge of achieving energy-efficient and accurate inference becomes increasingly critical. This work presents LightRot, a lightweight rotation scheme and dedicated hardware accelerator designed for low-bit LLM inference. The proposed architecture integrates Grouped Local Rotation (GLR) and Outlier Direction Aligning (ODA) algorithms with a hierarchical Fast Hadamard Transform (FHT)-based rotation unit to address key challenges in low-bit quantization, including the energy overhead of rotation operations. The proposed accelerator, implemented in a 28nm CMOS process, achieves a peak energy efficiency of 27.4 TOPS/W for 4-bit inference, surpassing prior state-of-the-art designs. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on higher-precision inference or evaluate on basic language modeling tasks like GPT-2, LightRot is optimized for advanced models such as LLaMA2-13B and LLaMA3-8B. Its performance is further validated on MT-Bench, demonstrating robust applicability to real-world conversational scenarios and redefining benchmarks for chat-based AI systems. By synergizing algorithmic innovations and hardware efficiency, this work sets a new paradigm for scalable, low-bit LLM inference, paving the way for sustainable AI advancements.

</details>


### [411] [ARES: Adaptive Reasoning-Effort Steering for PPA- and Cost-Aware RTL Optimization with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27879)
*Stef Cuyckens,Mihaela Jivanescu,Jun Yin,Chao Fang,Marian Verhelst*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Ares是一个LLM智能体优化框架，通过引入归一化美元成本来实现公平比较，并证明工程化的长期记忆并无实际增益，转而采用自适应推理努力策略（仅在低努力进展停滞时升级到更深推理），在三个未见测试设计上以相同归一化成本将FoM降低23-27%（最佳固定努力仅为16-23%），相比Dr. RTL节省88%的token并降低25%的FoM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在RTL设计PPA优化中存在三个问题：一是报告质量时不考虑归一化成本导致公平性缺失；二是将质量提升归因于工程化的跨设计记忆但缺乏验证；三是所有调用的推理努力固定不变导致资源浪费。作者旨在解决这些评估与效率问题。

Method: Ares包含三项创新：(1)引入每次LLM调用的归一化美元成本，与性能指标FoM并列报告，使不同努力水平和优化器之间的比较公平；(2)通过该成本核算实验发现，工程化长期记忆相对简单拼接相同经验并无可靠增益；(3)采用自适应推理努力策略，通过耐心计数器（在21个训练设计上拟合）在低努力进展停滞时才升级到更深推理，从而将推理资源分配到真正需要的地方而非均匀分布。

Result: 在三个未见过的测试设计上，自适应努力策略在相同归一化成本下将FoM降低23-27%，而最佳固定努力仅达到16-23%。Ares从LLM草拟的乘累加单元到高度手工优化版本之间缩小了最多83%的差距，并在仅使用Dr. RTL 12%的token情况下达到比其深25%的FoM。

Conclusion: Ares证明了在LLM智能体RTL PPAl优化中，推理努力的分配策略比记忆工程设计更为关键，自适应努力策略能以更低的成本实现更好的优化效果，为LLM智能体优化提供了更公平的评估框架和更高效的资源利用方式。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents optimize the power, performance, and area (PPA) of register-transfer-level (RTL) designs by iterating over edits, synthesis, and PPA analysis, paying a dollar cost for every LLM call. Prior agents report the quality reached without its normalized cost, attribute that quality to an engineered cross-design memory, and hold the reasoning effort of every call fixed. We propose Ares with three corresponding innovations. (1) We introduce a normalized dollar cost per LLM call reported alongside the figure of merit (FoM), enabling fair comparison across effort levels and optimizers. (2) Using this accounting, we find the construction of the long-term memory matters little. An engineered memory brings no dependable gain over a plain concatenation of the same experience. (3) We instead adapt the per-call reasoning effort by escalating to deeper reasoning only once progress at a lower effort stalls, via a patience counter fit on 21 training designs, allocating reasoning where it pays rather than uniformly across all iterations. On three test designs unseen during training, the effort policy lowers the FoM by 23-27% where the best fixed effort reaches 16-23%, at equal normalized cost. Ares closes up to 83% of the gap from an LLM-drafted multiply-accumulate unit to its highly hand-optimized counterpart, and reaches a 25% deeper FoM than state-of-the-art Dr. RTL at 12% of its tokens.

</details>


### [412] [Demystifying DRAM Read Disturbance: Bridging the Gap Between Experimental Characterization and Device-Level Modeling of RowHammer and RowPress Phenomena](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28233)
*Haocong Luo,Longda Zhou,Ataberk Olgun,İsmail Emir Yüksel,Nisa Bostanci,Zhigang Ji,Xing Wu,Onur Mutlu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文旨在弥合DRAM读取干扰（RowHammer和RowPress）在实验表征与器件级建模之间的鸿沟，通过识别现有物理机制模型与实验观察之间的不一致性，并利用TCAD仿真验证完善机制理解，为未来的理解、表征和缓解工作提供原理性基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DRAM读取干扰（如RowHammer和RowPress）会导致未访问的内存位置发生意外位翻转，严重影响系统安全与可靠性。然而，现有的器件级物理机制模型无法完全解释所有主要的实验观察结果，实验表征与理论模型之间存在明显脱节，缺乏统一的原理性框架。

Method: 本文首先识别并展示了现有器件级模型与实验表征之间在三个关键指标上的差异：1)位翻转方向、2)位翻转数量、3)首次触发位翻转所需的最小激活次数（ACmin）。随后，作者进行了全面严格的TCAD仿真，以匹配实验观察到的RowHammer和RowPress位翻转现象。

Result: 基于仿真结果，作者总结了更新后的器件级错误机制用于理解RowHammer和RowPress位翻转，并识别出对仿真结果匹配真实芯片表征有显著影响的关键建模和仿真参数。

Conclusion: 本文研究为DRAM读取干扰提供了原理性基础，对严格的实验表征方法学和DRAM读取干扰缓解技术的设计具有重要启示意义。

Abstract: DRAM read disturbance, like RowHammer and RowPress, is a critical robustness issue where accessing DRAM can cause unintended bitflips in other unaccessed DRAM locations. DRAM read disturbance bitflips significantly impact the safe, secure, and reliable operation of DRAM-based computing systems. Many prior works experimentally characterize these bitflips and propose mitigations based on empirical results. Other device-level works study their underlying physical mechanisms, but these mechanisms do not fully explain all major empirical observations.
  Our goal is to bridge the gap between experimental characterization and device-level modeling and understanding of RowHammer and RowPress, providing a principled foundation for future work on understanding, characterizing, and mitigating DRAM read disturbance. We first identify and demonstrate gaps and inconsistencies between the physical mechanisms of RowHammer and RowPress described by existing device-level models and experimental characterization of their bitflips. We focus on three fundamental metrics that should map to first-order physical mechanisms: 1) bitflip directions, 2) bitflip counts, and 3) the minimum number of aggressor row activations that trigger the first bitflips (i.e., ACmin). Second, we present a comprehensive and rigorous set of TCAD simulations that match phenomena observed in experimental characterizations of RowHammer and RowPress bitflips.
  From our results, we 1) summarize updated device-level error mechanisms for understanding RowHammer and RowPress bitflips, and 2) identify key modeling and simulation parameters that significantly affect whether simulation results match real-chip characterization. We discuss implications for 1) rigorous, comprehensive, and efficient experimental characterization methodologies of DRAM read disturbance bitflips, and 2) the design of DRAM read disturbance mitigation techniques.

</details>
